---
title: "Science meets Comics"
---

Cloud science is fascinating, and I believe that a broad audience should be able to enjoy it and understand why it matters. Together with illustrator [Laura Mayer](https://lauramayer.space/), I am working on a series of scientific comics. They explain EarthCARE, what it can measure, and why these measurements are important in an easy and engaging way.

The comics are still a work in progress and will be published on the ESA website by the end of this year. Stay tuned!
